# DuplexJev-B-Whisper-small-SmolLM3-3B

A small **DuplexJev** connector: the Whisper-small encoder (frozen) feeds a frozen **SmolLM3-3B**, and every typed question is read as a
single-token distribution over its options, with zero decode steps and many questions per forward pass. Trained with the
same recipe as the Qwen3-32B connectors released with the paper.

| | |
|---|---|
| Audio encoder (frozen) | [`openai/whisper-small`](https://huggingface.co/openai/whisper-small) |
| LLM (frozen) | [`HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B`](https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B) |
| Connector | last encoder layer → frame stacking + SwiGLU projector (B), 29.4 M trainable parameters |
| Audio tokens | 50 Hz encoder frames, 8 stacked → 6.25 audio tokens/s |
| Total parameters | 3193 M (encoder + LLM + connector) |
| This variant | Content alignment only (R1–R2, transcript distillation). No paralinguistic training: gender and emotion are at chance. A starting point for your own decision fine-tuning. |

## Quick start

```bash
pip install "duplexjev[speech]>=0.2.2"
```

```python
from duplexjev import Decider, Question

d = Decider.from_pretrained("adventists-ai/DuplexJev-B-Whisper-small-SmolLM3-3B")

d.decide("utterance_en.wav", [
    Question("turn", "Has the user finished speaking?", ["finished", "not finished"], lang="en"),
    Question("intent", "What does the user want?", ["climate", "media", "navigation", "phone", "chit-chat"], lang="en"),
], lang="en")
d.decide("utterance_zh.wav", [                            # Chinese speech: Chinese question and options
    Question("turn", "用户说完了吗？", ["说完了", "还没说完"], lang="zh"),
    Question("intent", "用户想做什么？", ["空调", "媒体", "导航", "电话", "闲聊"], lang="zh"),
], lang="zh")
```

The connector was trained with SmolLM3's no-think format (an empty `<think></think>` block before the answer). The tokenizer in this repository carries that chat template; SmolLM3's default template adds a long system prompt with today's date and would not match.

## Results

| Evaluation (%) | paper protocol | `duplexjev` 0.2.2 defaults |
|---|---:|---:|
| qa100 (spoken QA) | 38 | 40 |
| qa100, SmolLM3-3B reading the transcript | 77 | – |
| ZJU-ML (spoken QA, real + TTS) | 48 | – |
| Easy-Turn (4-way turn state, 800 clips) | 26.1 | – |
| Gender, 800 real utterances | 52.9 | 58 |
| Emotion, 4-way, 800 utterances | 30.1 | 29.2 |

Leaderboard scores (see the [GitHub README](https://github.com/adventists-ai/duplexjev)): main language (mean of qa100, ZJU-ML, Easy-Turn) **37.4**,
paralinguistics (mean of gender, emotion) **41.5**.

Paper protocol: the evaluation prompts of the paper (single option order, one H200). `duplexjev` defaults: the package's
own prompts with `lang` matched to the clip. Spoken QA with a small LLM is bounded by the LLM itself (see the
transcript-reading row); use these connectors for short decisions and speaker cues rather than open knowledge questions.

**Latency** of one decision event (10 questions, one 4.5 s clip, `duplexjev` 0.2.2, plain PyTorch): 6.5 s on 8 CPU threads (Xeon Platinum 8558, fp32, not quantized); about 149 ms on one H200 (bf16, measured while the GPU was shared with a training job).

## Training

Frozen encoder and LLM; only the connector is trained: R1 and R2 transcript distillation on two disjoint 0.5 M-utterance
packs of the Ultravox v0.6 mixture (32k steps each, global batch 16).
Code and scripts: [https://github.com/adventists-ai/duplexjev](https://github.com/adventists-ai/duplexjev).

## Limitations

- Evaluated on read or acted speech and small test sets (100–800 items); not on streaming input.
- Small LLMs answer knowledge questions poorly even from the transcript.
- Emotion labels come from acted corpora; do not use the outputs to make decisions about individuals.
- The connector only works with the encoder and LLM listed above.

## License

**Apache-2.0** for the connector weights. Some training corpora (e.g. WenetSpeech, CoVoST 2) are licensed for non-commercial use only; check them before commercial use. The frozen models keep their own licences: SmolLM3-3B (Apache-2.0) and the encoder (Apache-2.0).

## Citation

  title     = {Batched Speech Decisions Without Decoding: Single-Token Supervision Lets a Frozen {LLM} Hear Beyond the Transcript},
  author    = {Jin, Jie and Ma, Ziyin and Yin, Min and Chen, Jinyu and Song, Haigang and Pang, Zhikun and Zhang, Xiaowen},
  booktitle = {Submitted to IEEE ICASSP},
  year      = {2027}
}
```

| Connector | last encoder layer → frame stacking + SwiGLU projector (B), 30.4 M trainable parameters |

## Quick start

pip install "duplexjev[speech]>=0.2.2"
```

# DuplexJev-B-Para-MOSS-Transcribe-SmolLM3-3B

A small **DuplexJev** connector: the MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize audio encoder (Whisper architecture, 24 layers, 307 M) (frozen) feeds a frozen **SmolLM3-3B**, and every typed question is read as a
single-token distribution over its options, with zero decode steps and many questions per forward pass. Trained with the

| | |
|---|---|

| Audio tokens | 50 Hz encoder frames, 8 stacked → 6.25 audio tokens/s |

| This variant | R2 connector + 4k steps of the four-task mixture (transcription, continuation, gender, emotion) under the mixed objective: transcript distillation for content samples, answer-token cross-entropy for decision samples (the paper's MIX-KD recipe). Hears speaker gender and four-way emotion. |

    Question("emotion", "What is the speaker's emotional state?", ["neutral", "happy", "angry", "sad"], lang="en"),
], lang="en")
d.decide("utterance_zh.wav", [                            # Chinese speech: Chinese question and options
    Question("gender", "说话人的性别是？", ["男性", "女性"], lang="zh"),
    Question("emotion", "说话人当时的情绪状态是？", ["中性", "高兴", "生气", "伤心"], lang="zh"),
], lang="zh")

transcript-reading row); use these connectors for short decisions and speaker cues rather than open knowledge questions.

packs of the Ultravox v0.6 mixture (32k steps each, global batch 16), then 4k steps of MIX-KD on content + gender (AISHELL-1, LibriSpeech) + emotion (ESD, CREMA-D).
